_comment: Mods in the Ascension Dev instance that the CurseForge launcher does not track (they were placed by hand), by CurseForge project and file id, so the pack's manifest can name them. The pack builder reads this next to the launcher's own record (minecraftinstance.json). Ids read from CurseForge on 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-21. Never list a mod here whose third-party distribution is off and then bundle its jar (docs/technical/pack-extras.md).

mods.name: Lootr (Forge & NeoForge)
mods.why: every player gets their own copy of a chest's loot

mods.name: Sophisticated Core
mods.why: needed by Sophisticated Storage

mods.name: Sophisticated Storage
mods.why: chests and barrels with upgrades, so a group's base needs fewer, bigger blocks. 1.6.7.2193 was withdrawn from CurseForge on 2026-10-20 or 21 (its file page is gone), so the pack names 2184

mods.name: Tom's Simple Storage Mod
mods.why: one terminal for every chest; it has its own Sophisticated Storage support

mods.name: Waystones
mods.why: fast travel inside a world; pack/config/waystones-common.toml refuses any warp between worlds

mods.name: Mouse Tweaks
mods.why: drag and spread items in any inventory

mods.name: Double Doors
mods.why: click one door and its neighbour follows (alpha.2)

mods.name: Collective
mods.why: library needed by Double Doors

mods.name: GraveStone Mod
mods.why: a grave holds your items on death (alpha.2)

mods.name: FallingTree
mods.why: chop one log, the tree falls (alpha.2); its config sets sneak, durability and hunger costs

mods.name: Create: Aeroworks
mods.why: gyroscope, joystick and a control stand: ships that are easy to steer (alpha.3; the first Moon flight failed on controls)

mods.name: Create Propulsion: Simulated
mods.why: thrusters that burn fuel or run on power, replacing Create Simulated Thrusters (alpha.3, ADR-0030)

mods.name: Create Crafts & Additions
mods.why: electricity: store power and run a ship from it (alpha.3)

mods.name: Create Additions - Sable Compat
mods.why: Crafts & Additions' wires work on a ship (alpha.3)

mods.name: Farmer's Delight
mods.why: food: crops, a cooking pot, a cutting board (alpha.3)

mods.name: Paragliders
mods.why: a held glider, no armour slot; replaces Gliders. Spirit Orbs, vessels and statues are off (alpha.3)

mods.name: Traveler's Backpack
mods.why: a backpack with a sleeping bag in it; replaces Sophisticated Backpacks (alpha.3)

mods.name: Inventory Profiles Next
mods.why: sorting the player inventory and chests (alpha.3)

mods.name: libIPN
mods.why: needed by Inventory Profiles Next (alpha.3)

mods.name: Kotlin for Forge
mods.why: needed by Inventory Profiles Next (alpha.3)

mods.name: Xaero's Minimap
mods.why: the minimap (alpha.3)

mods.name: Xaero's World Map
mods.why: the full map; Xaero's Minimap works with it (alpha.3)

mods.name: Create: Petrochem
mods.why: crude oil on Earth and a refinery; kerosene, diesel and gasoline fuel Create Propulsion's liquid Thruster (ADR-0031). Diesel Generators is the fallback
